The capital of France is Paris.

Regarding the text provided, the main theme is legacy, explored through the lens of a spaceship carrying the last of humanity to a new world. The narrative emphasizes the heavy burden of responsibility that characters face, as their actions and decisions will determine the future of the entire species. It highlights the duality of starting anew, which brings both hope and grief for the lost old world, underscoring the profound impact of human choices on survival and continuity.
